reviews.title: Does what it's designed for
reviews.comment: It's excellent. There's no loss of sound quality when using the cat and helps a ton to prevent wind noises or noise from something rubbing against the mic. I recommend taking measurements as the length may be a bit large for some Razer mics. Otherwise, it's a breeze to roll on. Event it's too large, you can just roll up the bottom a bit and look totally normal.
reviews.author: Christian

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.comment: Works perfectly and fits just right. I definitely recommend!!!

reviews.title: No more plosive sounds
reviews.comment: I use the fuzzy one.  Works really well. I can now put my mouth right next to the mic, and there are zero popping noises from my breath.
reviews.author: Yeti777

reviews.title: Product that works as described
reviews.comment: Works as described. A nice filter which will block out most noise made from fans and breathing. The only problem was that it does not fully fit into my quad cast, but it does cover enough of it where it works fine.
